item.title: How to Customise Your CV for Every Job Application Using Claude
item.description: One-size-fits-all CVs do not work. Hiring managers spend only seconds on each screening. Applicant tracking systems (ATS) filter applications by keyword match. True CV customization for each role takes time. It means you research the employer, understand the team context, and reframe your experience with strategy. Most people skip this step entirely. This guide shows you how to use Claude with structured approval gates. You can customize your CV for every application without losing authenticity or inventing experience.
